description: Paid per call via x402 ($0.005): RLUSD on XRPL, USDC on Base or USDC/USDT on Solana. Checks a token, deployer or wallet for rug pulls proven on-chain (with the buyers' loss), rug-factory networks, linked wallets and possible fakes of known tokens; with deep=true also live contract red flags and the contract's own name and symbol checked against known tokens (mint, pause, blacklist, mutable fees, upgradeable code; ~5 s slower, same price). Returns a risk verdict (none, low, high, critical) with reasons and evidence; findings separates on-chain facts with transactions from heuristic signals. Critical requires on-chain proof. 'none' means no record, not that an address is safe. Call without payment to get the payment terms, then repeat with _meta["x402/payment"].

address.description: EVM address: token, deployer, wallet or contract.

chain.description: Optional chain name or id, for example base.

deep.description: Also run the live, read-only contract check (owner privileges such as mint, pause, blacklist, mutable fees, upgradeable proxy). About 5 s slower, same price. Flags alone raise the level to low at most.

name: check_address
title: On-chain risk check for an EVM token or wallet
